en: Now, where's LOSTELLE gotten to\ntoday?\pShe always brings me lunch every\nday right about now…

Hm? You, there!
Are you a friend of LOSTELLE's?\pHave you seen LOSTELLE around?
I don't know where she might be.\lShe should've been here long ago.\pLOSTELLE's a cutie - she got my
looks - so what if someone…\pWhat if something's happened to
my LOSTELLE?!\pPlease, help me find her!
Please go search THREE ISLAND!

Hah? What is this GAME CORNER?
How much sadder can this get?\pThose clowns…\pThey said they'd be waiting on the
island, so where are they?\pHey, you! Is this the only THREE
ISLAND around here?
Try waking up before you crawl out\nof bed, you punk.\pThis is TWO ISLAND!\pMove it! Get your filthy motorbike\nout of my place!
Huh…\nOh, oh, gotcha.\pTch…\nThese islands are confusing…
Would you look at that?\nThat punk scuffed up my floor.

Hey, but listen! I'm begging you,
you have to go to THREE ISLAND.\pIf anything were to happen to my
LOSTELLE…\pMy place is the house with the red
roof on THREE ISLAND.\pShe may just show up late here,
so I can't run off anywhere.\pThat's why I have to get you to do
me this big favor.
I'm sorry.\nWe're not running any games today.
We'll get the games going soon\nfor you!
So you rescued LOSTELLE?\nHow can I thank you?\pLOSTELLE, darling, forgive me!\pDaddy didn't know you were scared\nand in trouble!
LOSTELLE: It's okay, Daddy.\nI got to be friends with {PLAYER}!

Oh, what's that?
You're saying that this is for me?\pHow did you know that I love rare
rocks and gems?\pYou sure know how to make a guy
happy.
Oh, I see, this is from BILL!\nYou have to thank him for me!\pYou know, you've been fantastic.\nI want you to have this.
{PLAYER} received a MOON STONE\nfrom LOSTELLE's daddy.
Your BAG's not going to fit another\nthing…
All right, I'll get the GAME CORNER\nrunning right away.\pYou have to come visit with a\nfriend.
Listen, listen!\pPlease show me you being cool\nagain!
